Frequently Asked Questions

When was Fernando Valenzuela born?

Fernando Valenzuela was born on November 1, 1960.

Where was Fernando Valenzuela born?

Fernando Valenzuela was born in Navojoa, Mexico.

How tall was Fernando Valenzuela?

Fernando Valenzuela was 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much did Fernando Valenzuela weigh when playing?

Fernando Valenzuela weighed 180 lbs (81 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Fernando Valenzuela play?

Fernando Valenzuela played 17 seasons.

Is Fernando Valenzuela in the Hall of Fame?

Fernando Valenzuela has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Fernando Valenzuela play?

Fernando Valenzuela was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Fernando Valenzuela have?

Fernando Valenzuela had 2,074 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Fernando Valenzuela played for?

Fernando Valenzuela played for 6 teams; the California Angels, Baltimore Orioles, Los Angeles Dodgers, Philadelphia Phillies, San Diego Padres and St. Louis Cardinals.

How many World Series has Fernando Valenzuela won?

Fernando Valenzuela won 1 World Series.

When did Fernando Valenzuela retire?

Fernando Valenzuela last played in 1997.

What are Fernando Valenzuela's nicknames?

El Toro is a nickname for Fernando Valenzuela.
